d:
Enjoy the soulful melody “Sawan Nahin Bhadon Nahin” from the film Kudrat (1981) starring Rajesh Khanna and Hema Malini. Sung beautifully by Asha Bhosle and Suresh Wadkar, with music composed by the genius R.D. Burman, this timeless track captures the magic of love and longing from Bollywood’s golden era.

Music Director: R.D. Burman
Lyricist: Majrooh Sultanpuri
